value.title: Woodo
value.synopsis: The more things change, the more they stay the same. Coconna and Vanilla take a trip down memory lane by returning to where their story first began.

value.title: Kummen
value.synopsis: Despite Pol’s best efforts, Kummen plunged into war once again. By the time Chirico’s friends arrive, the government has erupted into a full-blown coup d’état.

value.title: Sansa
value.synopsis: Zophie once bore a vendetta against Chirico. Now an old woman, she takes in a stranger, but what will she do when she discovers who he really is?

value.title: Nulgerant
value.synopsis: Plots take shape as word spreads about the "Child of God" and people realize the fate of the galaxy is at stake. Chirico must escort the child to the Tower of Gomor.

value.title: Cocoon
value.synopsis: Chirico and Shako find themselves deep beneath the surface and in the company of a mysterious girl who warns them about the Doyo.

value.title: Infanti
value.synopsis: Forces converge above the planet. Chirico soldiers on, determined to rescue the child entrusted to him, and once again faces an important choice.
